title: More Than Burgers: Karl Willett on Second Chances and Community
summary: A restaurant owner’s story can reach far beyond the kitchen. Karl Willett of Just Burgers joins Jed Chappell to talk about second chances, dignity, and the people who help us keep going. He shares how his work in corrections and employment support shaped the way he sees people—and why creating a welcoming place to share a meal matters to him. From childhood memories in Missouri to building community in Oklahoma City, this conversation explores service, resilience, faith, friendship, and the connections we make around food.
